route_source: Shortest connected modeled walk among available mapped GIS entrances and explicitly estimated access points on the frozen NC State GIS network with documented pedestrian supplements. Reviewed, ground-level path intersections were noded in the Chapter Commons/Townhomes/Apartments plazas and Western Manor parking area; old GIS segments through the three Greek building interiors and older Western Manor manual parking traces were removed. Public OSM pedestrian ways and service/parking aisles were added for Western Manor; arterial/residential road centerlines, private/no-foot ways and grade-separated ways were excluded. Available mapped GIS entrances are restored for Western Manor; otherwise the retained estimated building-edge point is reconnected without crossing building interiors or arterial-road centerlines. No door or all-sides access is invented. The Bilyeu–Pullen pedestrian corridor and four estimated west-row Greek rear access options remain included. The external Western Manor sidewalk spine is retained; only older internal parking traces are replaced. GIS entrance 156 has no defensible outside-footprint connector within 30 m, so that building retains its estimated frontage access. Door permissions, crossing safety, accessibility and October-specific conditions are not certified.
